messages:
alex: Heads up — RidgeCompute reached out about a joint perf/W sweep. They have prototype boards and want to validate throughput vs power for rlm-13B and quantized rlm-7B. Looking for owners for orchestration and deliverables.

mira: Hi! Mira from RidgeCompute here — we can host Mon–Wed in our ridge-lab. Primary asks: kernel tuning + thermal profile capture. We can provide PDUs and power meter hookups.

samir: I can run the bench pipeline. Quick Q: do we have canonical prompts / trace inputs and target SLOs? Also need the exact kernel hashes and container images to reproduce.

jen: I'll own prompt set and evaluation harness. For SLOs: target p50 < 60ms on 2048 ctx for 13B, p95 < 180ms; sustain 80% throughput at ~250W. We'll measure both baseline and quantized variants.

alex: High-level plan: Day 1 — baseline compile + smoke runs; Day 2 — kernel tuning sweep (prefetch, GEMM backend, thread pinning); Day 3 — full run with telemetry and artifacts. @bench-bot reserve nodes 4x for Mon–Wed pls.

bench-bot: Reservation created: ridge-lab nodes[04-07], Mon 09:00 -> Wed 18:00 UTC. Reservation ID: RC-EFF-6167.

samir: Perfect. I'll push a minimal runner to /ci/ridge/bench-run.sh. Example command: `./bench-run.sh --model rlm-13b --quant none --batch 1 --ctx 2048 --out results/rc13b-baseline.csv`

jen: For baselines, disable KV/prefix caching. We'll run a second pass with caching enabled to measure delta. Capture these counters: GPU power, GPU freq, GPU temp, cupti kernel latencies, and system-level power from PDUs.

mira: PDUs 3 and 4 map to nodes 04-07. We'll provide power meter CSVs and thermocouple labels. Also note that our lab's ambient temp will be logged at the start of each run.

samir: Proposed sweep: quant levels = [none, int8, int8+gptq]; batch sizes = [1,4]; thread pins = [affinity A, affinity B]. That'll be ~12 configurations per model.

jen: Outputs we want: CSV summary, per-run flamegraphs, kernel latency histograms, telemetry tarball, and a short runbook describing config and reproduce steps. We'll also prepare a 1-page internal summary for product/marketing.

alex: Legal & announcement: partner asked for a 2-week embargo after runs to prepare co-announcement and Marketplace listing. @mira please confirm legal contact and any NDAs.

mira: Acknowledged. I'll pull in our legal contact; they prefer results-review before public slides. Two-week embargo is fine.

samir: One more technical: we should baseline with current upstream kernels, then test with our patched kernel (prefetch + GEMM). I'll enumerate the exact kernel flags in the PR: `KERNEL_PREFETCH=1 GEMM_BACKEND=nvGEMM THREAD_PIN=compact`.

jen: I'll place the eval set under evals/ridgecompute/ and link it in the PR. Also will include a small script to generate latency traces for p95 analysis.

alex: Action items summary: samir -> bench scripts + flag matrix + PR; jen -> evals + artifact templates + runbook; mira -> PDU mapping, lab access, legal contact; bench-bot -> reservation (done).

mira: Confirmed. Meeting to sync before the run on Friday 10:00 UTC. I'll book a slot and invite folks. :calendar:

alex: Friday 10 works for me. Thanks team.

jen: I'll draft the PR tonight and assign reviewers.

samir: I'll start compiling the container and baseline images Mon morning.

mira: We'll prep the power meters and thermal probes Tue AM.

alex: Thanks — we'll run the smoke Monday AM and iterate. End of thread.
